text: Law is a social science that studies legal phenomena. It not only explores the origin, essence, logic and development laws of law, but also focuses on how to adjust social relations, resolve conflicts and maintain fairness and justice through legal norms. From the signing of individual contracts to the construction of national rule of law, from the resolution of international disputes to the protection of social rights, law always revolves around the core proposition of "how rules shape social order", and is a discipline with both theoretical depth and practical value.
